## PR Summary

<!-- CURSOR_SUMMARY -->
**Low Risk**
Narrow forwarding fix in the music client wrapper with a regression test; no auth, security, or data-model changes.

**Overview**
Fixes a bug where **`client.music.compose_detailed`** accepted `seed`, `finetune_id`, `respect_sections_durations`, and `with_waveform_visual` but never sent them to the API. The custom sync/async wrappers in `music_custom.py` re-declared only part of the raw client signature; extras landed in `**kwargs` and were dropped on the call to `_raw_client.compose_detailed`.

The change adds those four parameters on both **`MusicClient`** and **`AsyncMusicClient`** and passes them through like the other request fields. A unit test asserts the raw client receives the values (previously failed with missing keys such as `seed`).
